# ATTRIBUTION.md
This document explains how AI-generated code is annotated within the repository and lists all modules and functions that were fully generated by AI (ChatGPT).

## 1. Attribution Methodology
### Python source files (.py):
*   Any function that was fully generated by ChatGPT contains an inline comment directly above its definition:
```
# AI-generated via ChatGPT
def function_name(...):
    ...
```
Files in which multiple functions were AI-generated include a short file-level note at the top.

### Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb):
*   Any notebook cell containing fully AI-generated code includes a cell-level annotation:
```
# All functions in this cell were AI-generated via ChatGPT.
```
or
```
# AI-generated via ChatGPT 
```

## 3. Dataset Attribution

This project uses one external dataset:

* **“MIDI Classic Music”** by blanderbuss  
  Source: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/blanderbuss/midi-classic-music  
  License: Publicly available via Kaggle  
  Usage: The MIDI files were preprocessed into token sequences for training the GRU model.  
  All preprocessing steps were performed by the student, using some AI-generated helper functions as listed above.

No other external datasets or data sources were used.

I confirm that all fully AI-generated code is clearly annotated inline and listed in this document. All remaining code was authored by me, with AI assistance limited to debugging, clarification, or minor refinement.
